title: FlexNOC: A Flexible NoC Architecture for Heterogeneous AI Accelerators
problem: Static network-on-chip designs with fixed routing and bandwidth allocation cannot efficiently handle heterogeneous AI accelerators where workloads exhibit diverse communication patterns. This inflexibility wastes energy and limits performance across varying AI workload types.
motivation: Adapting NoC resources dynamically based on runtime workload characteristics can substantially improve energy efficiency in AI systems.
method: FlexNOC watches how an AI accelerator's workloads actually communicate at runtime—which parts need to talk to each other and how much data they're sending. Based on these patterns, it reconfigures the network-on-chip (the system connecting different processing components) by adjusting how data flows between them and how much data capacity each link gets. This avoids wasting energy on unused paths and bandwidth, all without changing the physical hardware.
key_novelty: The network-on-chip automatically adjusts its routing and bandwidth allocation during runtime based on what the AI workload actually needs, instead of using one fixed network configuration for all workloads.
contributions: FlexNOC architecture enabling dynamic routing and bandwidth adaptation
Workload-aware reconfiguration mechanism for network-on-chip systems
25% improvement in energy efficiency over static NoC baselines
Experimental validation on diverse AI workloads across heterogeneous accelerators
